{{Top|leg}}
A '''concussion-sphere launcher''' was a short range [[Starship/Legends|starship]] mounted projectile weapon. The underslung mandibles of [[Corellia StarDrive]]'s [[Coruscant-class Heavy Courier|''Coruscant''-class Heavy Courier]] were each equipped with a concussion-sphere launcher loaded with eight [[concussion sphere]]s.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
